title: ilex ambigua subsp. macropoda
intro: Ilex ambigua subsp. macropoda, commonly known as Ilex macropoda, is a plant species belonging to the family Aquifoliaceae. It is a type of evergreen holly tree native to China, valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Ilex macropoda include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
